candidates.change_summary: Change require value from 10 ether to 0 ether so fallback can be called with different msg.value.
Delete the first require so fallback can be called without sending any ether.
Change block.timestamp > pastBlockTime to >= so same-block calls can succeed, affecting state updates and possible transfers.
Delete the timestamp require so pastBlockTime check is removed, allowing unlimited calls in the same block.
Change pastBlockTime update to a constant nonzero value so subsequent calls always fail the timestamp require.
Delete the pastBlockTime assignment so state is not updated, allowing repeated calls in same block after first one.
Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0 so transfer occurs on non-multiples of 15 instead.
Change division modulus from 15 to 1 so transfer happens on every call (except block 0).
Delete the if-block condition and transfer so fallback never transfers balance.
